newsitem.title: ITALY: Berlsuconi supporter joins Italy government party.
newsitem.headline: Berlsuconi supporter joins Italy government party.

text.p: A senior politician from former prime minister Silvio Berlusconi's Forza Italia party said on Friday he was quitting the opposition group and joining a small government coalition party headed by Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini.

Silvio Liotta, a former chairman of parliament's budget commission, announced his move to Dini's Italian Renewal party in a statement and predicted that there would be more cross-party changes in the future.
"Italian Renewal...is a place of balance and dialogue which is still inspired by Christian principles," he said.
Dini's party, which was formed last year, split in two in December after months of infighting.

Berlusconi recently accused Dini of trying to poach his Forza Italia politicians in a bid to rebuild his parliamentary numbers. Liotta's decision means Italian Renewal now has 15 members in the 630-seat Chamber of Deputies.
